entities.summary: Jumpstyle is an electronic dance music genre that emerged in Western Europe in the late 1990s, particularly in Belgium and the Netherlands. It is associated with a distinctive dance style commonly referred to as jumpen. jumpstyle is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
